package.name: crazyflie_interfaces
package.description:
Vendored subset of the Crazyswarm2 crazyflie_interfaces package (IMRCLab, MIT). Field names and types match upstream 1.0.6 verbatim so this is a drop-in: if ros-humble-crazyflie-interfaces is installed later it supersedes this without any code change on our side.
Vendored rather than apt-installed because the machine this was assembled on had no package-manager access. Only the messages and services the driver actually uses are included; trajectory upload, logging add/remove and connection statistics are not.
